notes: 1.1.159: Ads Account + BM read now complete. Ads shows each ad account's status + disable reason + creation date + spend LIMIT (e.g. 6275.1 BDT) + amount spent; if no ad account exists it is created and shown. BM now shows every Business Manager's name + creation date + its own status (Verified / Not verified / In review / Rejected / Revoked) so you can see at a glance if a BM is live or flagged - the '1'/'2' before it is just how MANY BMs. (Spend limit is a per-ad-account value, shown in the Ads column; Facebook keeps no separate BM spend limit.) Also: a one-time self-heal fixes rows an earlier build left wrong - the account's screen Location that slipped into the BM cell moves back to Primary Location, and a stray 'Yes' in Primary Location is cleared. name/gender/birthday fill at login and retry next login if missed; only the checks you tick run.
